dates.note: placed among siddhas of Avantivarman's reign; no exact dates — royal date is association, not composition date

name: Bhatta Kallata
summary: Pupil of Vasugupta at the Spanda source: on the Pradipika account he versified the received doctrine as the Spandakarikas (recensions disagree — preserve the dispute); his own explanatory work is the Spandavrtti (Stein also titles it Spandasarvasva). Also Tattvartha-cintamani on the Sivasutras (Bhaskara) and Spanda-sutra-varttika.
